fields.statement: At 7f653b81 (after fix 1a5e3269), built rhiza to a scratch path and ran `rhiza tui app autonomy` live in a Rex window over a fresh scratch repo, driven with rex send-key. With permissionMode unset, d then y said 'Starting the daemon in the Rex tab rhiza daemon', then within one reload 'The daemon did not start: its error is in the Rex tab rhiza daemon'; that tab stayed open showing the daemon's 'no permission mode' error (the cycle-1 QA finding is fixed). Edited permissionMode to acceptEdits in place (source became git config); d y then showed 'The daemon is running in the Rex tab rhiza daemon' with header 'Daemon running, process Mac.localdomain:54983'; d y again sent TERM, the process was gone and the header said 'Daemon not running'. Enter toggled paused false->true and plan owner->auto, both from git config. go test autonomyapp and TestScripts/(tui-autonomy-app|rex-install) pass.

At 7f653b81, with the built binary against this live run session in Rex: `rhiza session pane <own session> --json` returned the pane's real text (the Claude Code prompt and status line) with usage_limit false; `rhiza session key <session> escape --dry-run --json` returned dry_run true and sent nothing; key 'tab' was refused ('want escape or enter', exit 2). Escape into a live agent pane and the inbox app's n on a real stalled item were not run (no stalled session to use without disrupting a live agent), so the escape-then-message order rests on go test ./internal/tui/inboxapp, ./internal/api and TestScripts/session-pane-key, all passing.
